# init_workspace v2.14.0

Release date: 2026-05-18

## Highlights

- Added `G01_HTML交互产物_v1.0.0`, a project-level entry for generating single-file HTML reports, diagrams, decision artifacts, data explorers, and lightweight interactive tools.
- Refreshed bundled initializer templates from the live workspace, now including 29 registered Skills and `workspace-spec.json` v1.20.0.
- Rebuilt and published the Windows Release asset as `init_workspace_v2.14.0.exe`.

## Added

- `G01_HTML交互产物_v1.0.0` keeps the imported 16-mode HTML skill package in references while exposing one controlled local entrypoint.
- The bundled templates include the G01 Skill, HTML mode index, localized references, assets, and Claude command wrapper.
- Added HTML documentation under `output/02_Skills管理体系_v1.22.0/02_课题研究_v1.7.0/`, including the G01 usage guide and the `init_workspace` project overview.

## Changed

- `SKELETON_VERSION` is now `2.14.0`.
- `SSO_SPEC_VERSION` is aligned to `workspace-spec.json` v1.20.0.
- `Skills管理标准.md` is aligned to v1.13.0 and adds the G-domain HTML artifact category.
- README version and build paths now point to the v2.14.0 initializer.
- The initializer bundle was regenerated from current live sources:
  - `AGENTS.md`
  - `CLAUDE.md`
  - 4 files under `.agents/rules`
  - 227 files under `.agents/skills`
  - 4 files under `.system/standards`
- B09 release manifests are included in the source tree to make the template update and executable build reproducible and auditable.

## Validation

- B01 framework health check passed: `31 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 WARN`.
- The rebuilt asset SHA256 was recalculated and matched the B09 build manifest.
- The release candidate was checked for private/runtime content boundaries before push: `.Claude.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.memory/`, `.history/`, `.temp/`, `input/`, and `*.exe` are not part of the normal commit payload.

## Upgrade Notes

- Existing workspaces can upgrade in place. The initializer backs up managed entry files, rules, Skills, standards, and Claude command wrappers before replacing them with bundled templates.
- G01 adds HTML artifact generation capability without changing the existing B/A/C/D/E/F Skill call patterns.
- Download `init_workspace_v2.14.0.exe` from this Release's assets.
